# Stage 15 matched comparisons

Post hoc on the confirmation panel; licenses no frozen route. CNN-F and CNN-noF have no development-panel runs; no independent equivalence margin is available. These readings form a frontier, not an equivalence test.

Ranking: descending modal probability; ties by the single fixed namespace-seeded permutation, independent of outcomes; reused across models, leads and pattern subsets.

R-other: the initial seven-pattern coverage count used a floating-point product followed by truncation. The corrected count rounds the prescribed fraction before selecting questions. The earlier receipt is superseded for these readings and retained separately for registry history.


Bounds and all forecast calibration tests are recorded at full precision in receipts/acd_stage15_matching.json. Instance means omit instances without selected answers. Fc has one answer per contributing instance, so pooled and equal-case accuracy and their exact one-sided Clopper–Pearson intervals coincide. E/C decisions are referenced without recomputation; receipt-only response models are retained.
